scripts.postbuild: cp package.json dist/ && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const pkg = require('./dist/package.json'); const corePkg = require('../../packages/core/package.json'); pkg.name = '@vm0/runner'; delete pkg.private; delete pkg.scripts; delete pkg.devDependencies; pkg.dependencies['@vm0/core'] = corePkg.version; pkg.bin['vm0-runner'] = 'index.js'; pkg.files = ['.']; fs.writeFileSync('./dist/package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2));"
